$comment: FORM P4-T4 retroactive admission record (the slot predates the budget, so it is also in baselineSlots; this record documents why it earned its place). Written after the fact; apps, probe and teaching line checked against the files on 2026-11-17.

declarative.why: names WHO may start the flow (api | ui | internal); no ordering, no logic

notLower.why: whether a flow has a public POST route is decided by the platform when it emits the API; a function cannot withhold an endpoint, and an internal flow is reachable only through callFlow

taught.bundleLine: "expose":"api|ui|internal" (default api; ui and internal flows have no public POST, it answers 404; an internal flow is only started by a callFlow)
